idea-plugin.name: HTTP Request Designer
idea-plugin.description:
A graphical editor for IntelliJ HTTP Client files (.http / .rest).
  • Build requests with standard or custom HTTP methods, query parameters, headers and bodies
  • Prefill requests from routes detected in the Endpoints (OpenAPI) view and OpenAPI files
  • {{variable}} completion from http-client.env.json environments, in-file variables and dynamic variables
  • Authentication dashboard: Basic, Digest, Bearer, API key and OAuth 2.0 (Security.Auth)
  • Test builder that generates client.test(...) response handler checks
The designer edits the same document as the text editor, so changes show up live in both directions.
